source:
......



...[PROCESSING TRANSMISSION]...



.....

".......mdmdnefgrmxmcxndendkeglnksjns....H-.....Hi.....Hi, my-.... my name is Balthazar Brook. A young wolf beastman who's also around in his 20s. Occupation? Well, I'm not here to brag but if you insist then I'll tell you. I'm an incredibly famous hero in a world called Agrian, a world where various kinds of races and species lived in harmony and peace-..... GAAAH!!! What the hell am I doing?! SOMEBODY HELP ME!!! I suddenly got myself transferred into another world like in some kind of a cliche isekai anime would! I don't know how! BUT IT JUST HAPPENED!! And the forest?! There's something very wrong about that place! I don't know what to do either. Should I stay? Or should I wander around hoping to find some answers like they did in the movie? Besides, this world sucks! There's no internet, no reception, no electricity, and no nothing! And what happened to my squad?! Where are they?! I'm worried about them. I swear! I'll find the one who's responsible for this hell that fell upon me and give me the answer I'm dying to know of!"

[END TRANSMISSION]

.....



.....

“……mdmdnefgrmxmcxndendkeglnksjns……呼——……嗨……嗨，我的——我的名字叫巴尔萨扎·布鲁克，是一名二十多岁的年轻狼兽人。职业？好吧，我不是来吹牛的，既然你坚持，那我就告诉你。我是阿格里安世界里赫赫有名的英雄。那是一个各种种族和物种和谐共存的世界——……啊啊啊！我到底在做什么！？谁来帮帮我！我突然被转移到了另一个世界，就像老套异世界动画里的情节一样！我也不知道原因，但事情就是发生了！还有这片森林！？这里有些不对劲！我也不知道该怎么办。是该留下来，还是像电影里的人那样四处游荡、寻找答案？更糟的是，这个世界糟透了！没有网络，没有信号，没有电，什么都没有！我的小队又怎么样了！？他们在哪里！？我很担心他们。我发誓，我一定会找到把我扔进这场地狱的人，得到那个让我日夜渴望知道的答案！”

[传输结束]
